text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa defeated Special Week, 
sending the crowd into a frenzy.

Unsatisfied by this race alone, Special 
Week passionately longs for a rematch at 
the Arima Kinen.

Special Week, Grass Wonder, and El Condor 
Pasa—these three are destined to clash at 
the Arima Kinen.

The Arima Kinen, where three close 
comrades gather. With a star-studded 
lineup confirmed to race, the spectators' 
hearts swelled with anticipation.
